item.content:encoded:
Remote · Portugal · Full time · Communications · Salary: 1200-2000

Speak French and English fluently, have at least one year of call centre experience, and feel confident selling? Join an international team supporting customers in the telecommunications sector, working remotely from Portugal.

This role combines customer support with a strong sales focus. After resolving each customer enquiry, you’ll be expected to deliver a sales pitch and actively try to sell an additional service, tailoring your recommendation to the customer’s needs.

What You’ll Do

  • Support French-speaking customers by phone, email and chat;
  • Resolve enquiries about accounts, billing, subscriptions and telecommunications services;
  • Troubleshoot technical issues and escalate complex cases when needed;
  • Deliver a sales pitch at the end of each resolved case, introducing an additional service relevant to the customer;
  • Identify cross-selling and upselling opportunities, explain benefits and handle objections;
  • Work towards sales, customer satisfaction and service quality targets;
  • Guide customers through products, services and digital tools.

What You’ll Bring

  • French and English at C1/C2 level;
  • At least one year of customer service experience in a call centre or contact centre - mandatory;
  • A strong sales mindset and willingness to pitch additional services after resolving customer enquiries;
  • Clear communication, persuasive skills and confidence handling objections;
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail;
  • Confidence using digital tools and learning new systems;
  • The ability to balance customer care with commercial objectives;
  • Availability to work remotely from Portugal on rotating shifts.

Previous experience in telesales, cross-selling or upselling is an advantage.

Salary and Allowances

Monthly amount

  • Base salary €920
  • French and English language allowance €250
  • Performance bonus Up to €360
  • Attendance allowance €110
  • Flex work allowance €60
  • Meal allowance €10.20 per working day

Potential monthly package: approximately €1,914, including the maximum performance bonus, all listed allowances and meal allowance for 21 working days. The total varies according to performance, allowance eligibility and days worked.

What We Offer

  • Fully remote work within Portugal;
  • Permanent contract after six months;
  • Health insurance;
  • An international, multicultural working environment;
  • Career development opportunities.

Working Schedule

  • Full-time;
  • Rotating shifts between 07:00 and 21:00;
  • Shifts scheduled across Monday to Sunday.

Ready to Apply?

If you enjoy solving customer problems and turning conversations into sales opportunities, we’d like to hear from you.

Apply with your CV. A minimum of one year of call centre experience is required.

item.content:encoded:
Porto, Portugal · Full time · Customer Service · Salary: 1000 - 1400

Tu maîtrises le français et tu aimes aider les autres à trouver des solutions ? Rejoins une entreprise de renom dans le secteur des télécommunications, au sein d’une équipe en pleine croissance à Porto.

Dans ce poste en présentiel, tu accompagneras les clients dans leurs demandes du quotidien : abonnements, facturation et assistance technique. Ton objectif : comprendre chaque situation et apporter une réponse claire, personnalisée et efficace.

Tes missions

  • Répondre aux appels entrants et aux demandes reçues par les canaux digitaux ;
  • Écouter les clients, identifier leurs besoins et les accompagner avec professionnalisme et empathie ;
  • Traiter les questions liées aux abonnements, aux factures et aux services de télécommunications ;
  • Guider les clients dans la résolution de difficultés techniques ;
  • Assurer le suivi des demandes et transmettre les situations complexes aux équipes compétentes ;
  • Mettre à jour les informations dans les outils internes pour garantir un suivi rigoureux ;
  • Contribuer aux objectifs de qualité de service et de satisfaction client ;
  • Collaborer avec tes collègues et partager les bonnes pratiques.

Ton profil

  • Français de niveau C2, à l’oral comme à l’écrit ;
  • Résidence à moins de 30 km du bureau de Porto, pour travailler en présentiel ;
  • Excellentes capacités de communication et d’écoute ;
  • Esprit d’analyse et goût pour la résolution de problèmes ;
  • Attitude positive, patience et sens du service ;
  • Aisance avec les outils informatiques et capacité à apprendre de nouveaux systèmes ;
  • Esprit d’équipe et envie de développer tes compétences.

Rémunération et primes

  • Salaire de base : 1 020 € bruts par mois, versés sur 14 mois ;
  • Indemnité repas : 9,60 € nets par jour travaillé, soit environ 211 € nets pour 22 jours travaillés ;
  • Prime de performance : 100 € fixes par mois pendant les trois premiers mois, puis un montant selon les résultats, avec un versement sur 12 mois ;
  • Prime qualité : jusqu’à 150 € bruts par mois ;
  • Contrat à durée indéterminée après trois mois.

Avantages complémentaires

  • Assurance santé privée et assurance vie après quatre mois ;
  • Remboursement des transports en commun jusqu’à 40 € par mois ;
  • Une expérience dans le secteur des télécommunications ;
  • Un environnement de travail qui favorise l’entraide et le partage de connaissances.

Envie de nous rejoindre ?

Si tu recherches un poste où tu peux utiliser ton français au quotidien, résoudre des problèmes concrets et accompagner les clients, nous souhaitons te rencontrer.

Envoie-nous ton CV et candidate dès maintenant !

Lisboa, Portugal · Full time · Telecommunications · Salary: 1200-1500

Interested in technology and enjoy helping people? Join an international customer support project supporting a leading global technology company’s digital services and AI-powered tools.

We’re hiring English-speaking Customer Support Specialists for full-time, on-site positions in Entrecampos, Lisbon, with day and night shift opportunities.

What You’ll Do

  • Handle enquiries about subscriptions, account management, billing and renewals;
  • Troubleshoot issues with digital platforms and services;
  • Guide users through premium features and AI-powered tools;
  • Make outbound calls when needed to follow up on customer enquiries;
  • Share feedback and contribute to improvements in the customer experience.

What You’ll Bring

  • Fluent written and spoken English;
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills;
  • A customer-focused approach and attention to detail;
  • An interest in technology, digital platforms and artificial intelligence;
  • Confidence using computers and learning new systems;
  • Availability to work on-site in Entrecampos, Lisbon.
  • Previous experience in customer service or technical support is an advantage.

Choose Your Shift Preference

We’re recruiting for two schedules, both with 40 working hours per week and two rotating days off per week.

  • Day shift

Rotating shifts within the 07:00–22:00 operating window;
Scheduled across Monday to Sunday.

  • Night shift

Rotating shifts within the 22:00–07:00 operating window;
Scheduled across Monday to Sunday.

Salary and Benefits

  • Base salary: €938 gross per month;
  • Holiday and Christmas allowances: paid in monthly instalments;
  • Meal allowance: €7 per working day;
  • Performance bonus: up to €300 per month, depending on results;
  • Private health and dental insurance: available after signing the contract;
  • Initial training: 10 working days, with compensation conditional on successful completion;
  • Modern offices in Entrecampos, with convenient public transport connections;
  • Experience supporting digital services within an international technology project.

Additional hourly pay for eligible night and weekend hours

Night hours, 22:00–00:00 +25%

Night hours, 00:00–07:00 +50%

Ready to Apply?

If you’re fluent in English, curious about technology and motivated to help customers, we’d like to hear from you.

Apply with your CV and tell us whether you prefer the day or night shift.

item.content:encoded:
Lisboa, Portugal · Full time · Technology · Salary: 1350 - 1550

Location: Hybrid (Lisbon Area)
Workload: Full-Time

Position Overview

We are currently looking for Dutch-speaking Tier 1 Technical Support Specialist to join a growing support team. This is an exciting opportunity to provide technical assistance to users of a global technology platform. If you're tech-savvy, sales-oriented, and fluent in Dutch and English, this role could be your next big move.

Job Summary

As a Level 1 Technical Support Specialist in our eMobility call center, you will serve as the first point of contact for customers experiencing issues with electric vehicle (EV) charging stations. Your primary responsibility is to provide prompt, professional, and technically sound support to ensure minimal downtime and a positive customer experience. You will perform basic troubleshooting, escalate complex issues, and contribute to the efficient operation of our EV charging infrastructure.

Main Responsibilities

  • Respond to customer inquiries via phone, email, or chat regarding EV charger functionality, connectivity, and usage.
  • Perform initial diagnostics on charging stations, including power status, network connectivity, and user interface issues.
  • Guide customers through standard troubleshooting steps such as resets, cable inspections, and mobile app configurations.
  • Escalate unresolved or complex issues to Tier 2 support or field service teams, ensuring detailed and accurate documentation.
  • Contribute to knowledge management and continuous improvement based on daily operations and recurring issues.
  • Prioritize case handling based on service level agreements (SLAs), warranty status, and issue severity.
  • Accurately log all support interactions and technical findings in the ticketing system (e.g., MS Dynamics 365 Customer Service).
  • Monitor and report recurring technical issues to support trend analysis and product reliability improvements.
  • Stay current with the latest EV charger models, firmware updates, and support procedures.
  • Ensure compliance with safety and operational standards during all remote support interactions.

Candidate Profile

  • Fluency in Dutch and proficient in English.
  • High school diploma or equivalent required; technical training or certifications in IT, electronics, or automotive systems are a plus.
  • Experience in a customer-facing technical support role, preferably in a call center or eMobility environment.
  • Basic understanding of electrical systems, IoT devices, and network troubleshooting (e.g., Wi-Fi, Ethernet, SIM-based connectivity).
  • Familiarity with EV charging standards and protocols (e.g., Type 2, CCS, OCPP) is an advantage.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical users.
  • Proficiency in using CRM and ticketing systems.
  • Ability to work in a shift-based environment, including weekends and holidays.
  • Preferably has experience managing different support channels (chat, email, voice, back office).
  • Work in a hybrid setup.
  • Residence in the Lisbon area.

Work Schedule

  • Rotating shifts ensure 24/7 coverage.
  • Monday–Friday (8:00–17:00) shifts are in-office; all other shifts are remote.

Compensation & Benefits Package

  • Basic Salary: EUR 950.00 gross/month
  • Language Allowance (Dutch + English): EUR 400.00/month
  • Meal Allowance of EUR 10.20 per day worked - up to EUR 224.40/month
  • Transport Allowance: EUR 40.00/month
  • Full training provided and paid
  • Health insurance after probation period

Why Apply?

  • Join a fast-growing and reputable company in the customer experience space.
  • Support a global tech brand with a dynamic and collaborative team.
  • Receive extensive training and real opportunities for career growth.
  • Enjoy a competitive salary and attractive benefits package.

If you're fluent in Dutch, tech-savvy, and eager to help customers solve technical problems — we’d love to hear from you!

By applying, you are giving your GDPR consent for your CV and personal details to be processed for recruitment purposes.
